```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];
```

```
}
```

```
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == -1;
      @*/
    public static long calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

            break;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @

      @          (\forall int i,j; 0 <= i && i < A.length && 0 <= j && j < A[0].length;
      @               \result[i][j] == A[A.length-1-i][A[0].length-1-j]));

        //@ decreases m - i;
```

```
      @                    (long)a[ii][jj] + (long)b[ii][jj] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE &&
      @                    (long)a[ii][jj] + (long)b[ii][jj] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE));
```

```
      @ ensures \result != null;
      @ ensures \result.length == a.length;
      @ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length;
      @             \result[i] != null && \result[i].length == a[0].length);
      @ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length;
      @             (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < a[0].length;
      @                 \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        /*@
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining n == a.length && m == a[0].length;
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n;
          @                (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < m;
          @                     (long)a[ii][jj] + (long)b[ii][jj] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE &&
          @                     (long)a[ii][jj] + (long)b[ii][jj] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE));
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < i;
          @                (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < m; c[ii][jj] == a[ii][jj] + b[ii][jj]));
          @ loop_writes c[*][*];
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            /*@
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= m;
              @ maintaining (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < j; c[i][jj] == a[i][jj] + b[i][jj]);

              @                (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < m; c[ii][jj] == a[ii][jj] + b[ii][jj]));

              @ maintaining (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj && jj < m;

              @                  (long)a[i][jj] + (long)b[i][jj] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE);
              @ loop_writes c[i][*];
              @ decreases m - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {

                wordStart = true;

            }
        }

    }
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      ensures \result == null;
      also
      // Case: valid inputs -> return fresh concatenated array
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;

        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
```

```
public class Mul {
```
```
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@                ( ((long)vec[i] * (long)a) > Integer.MAX_VALUE
    //@                    ? Integer.MAX_VALUE
    //@                    : ( ((long)vec[i] * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
    //@                        ? Integer.MIN_VALUE
    //@                        : (int)((long)vec[i] * (long)a) ) ) );
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= vec.length;
        //@ maintaining ret != null && ret.length == vec.length && \fresh(ret);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@                ret[j] ==
        //@                  ( ((long)vec[j] * (long)a) > Integer.MAX_VALUE
        //@                      ? Integer.MAX_VALUE
        //@                      : ( ((long)vec[j] * (long)a) < Integer.MIN_VALUE
        //@                          ? Integer.MIN_VALUE
        //@                          : (int)((long)vec[j] * (long)a) ) ) );
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases vec.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    //@ also
    //@   requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@   assigns \nothing;

    //@ also
    //@   requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@   assigns \result[*];
    //@   ensures \result != null;
```

```
public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                if (arr[i] == arr[j]) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
```

```
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        return ret;

}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    //@  requires a != null;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures a.length == 0 ==> \result == -1;
    //@  ensures a.length > 0 ==>
    //@            (0 <= \result && \result < a.length
    //@             && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] <= a[\result])
    //@             && (\forall int k; 0 <= k < \result; a[k] < a[\result]));
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index && index <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= biggest && biggest < a.length;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
```

```
        long sum = (long)a + (long)b;
        if (sum > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if (sum < Integer.MIN_VALUE)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        return (int)sum;
```

```
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {

                res = res + 1;

}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    //@  requires adjacencyMat != null;
    //@  requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int p,q; 0 <= p && p < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= q && q < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);
    //@  pure
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;
        //@ assert nVert == adjacencyMat.length;

        /*@
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= nVert;
          @ // For every processed row p (< i), all entries to its right have been checked:
          @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
          @                 (\forall int q; p+1 <= q && q < nVert; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]));
          @ loop_writes \nothing;
          @ decreases nVert - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // Keep the outer invariant and additionally record progress for row i:
              @ maintaining 0 <= i && i < nVert;
              @ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= nVert;
              @ // outer invariant (rows < i) still hold
              @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
              @                 (\forall int q; p+1 <= q && q < nVert; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]));
              @ // for the current row i, entries with column < j have been checked
              @ maintaining (\forall int k; i+1 <= k && k < j; adjacencyMat[i][k] == adjacencyMat[k][i]);
              @ loop_writes \nothing;
              @ decreases nVert - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
    //@  behaviors complete;
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k && k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p && p < i;
        //@               (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < n ==> ret[p][q] == A[m-1-p][n-1-q]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*][*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int q; 0 <= q && q < j ==> ret[i][q] == A[m-1-i][n-1-q]);
            //@ loop_writes ret[i][*], j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@            ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@             (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@             (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@             (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@             (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)))
    //@       &&
    //@       (digits.length % 2 == 0 ||
    //@        (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 ||
    //@         digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 ||
    //@         digits[digits.length / 2] == 8))
    //@   );
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;

        //@            (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes i;

            }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyDecreasing {
    public static boolean IsStrictlyDecreasing(int[] arr) {
        int n = arr.length;
        if (n < 2) {
            return true;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
```

```
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class IsPowerOfTwo {
    public static boolean isPowerOfTwo(int n) {
        if (n <= 0) return false;

        while (n > 1) {
            if (n % 2 != 0) return false;
            n /= 2;
```

```
public class IsPalindrome {
    public static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int n = s.length();

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

    }
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;

            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    //@  requires a == null || b == null || (long)a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ also
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && (long)a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result != null;
    //@  ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
    //@  ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i];
    //@  ensures \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < b.length; \result[a.length + j] == b[j];
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i; ret[k] == a[k];
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;

        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i; ret[m + k] == b[k];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k && k < m; ret[k] == a[k];
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
```

```
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i; ret[k] == a[k]);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*];
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i; ret[m + k] == b[k]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < m; ret[k] == a[k]);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*];
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {

            return false;
```

```
public class Find {
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (a != null && a.length > 0 &&
    //@           (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length;
    //@               a[i] != null && a[i].length == a.length &&
    //@               (\forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length;
    //@                   (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0))));
    //@  pure
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p < i;
        //@                 a[p] != null && a[p].length == n &&
        //@                 (\forall int q; 0 <= q < n;
        //@                     (p == q ? a[p][q] == 1 : a[p][q] == 0)));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining a[i] != null && a[i].length == n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int q; 0 <= q < j;
            //@                 (i == q ? a[i][q] == 1 : a[i][q] == 0));
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    //@  requires adjacencyMat != null;
    //@  requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[r] != null && adjacencyMat[r].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= j < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
    //@  pure
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p < q && q < nVert && p < i; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases nVert - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            //@ maintaining i >= 0 && i < nVert;
            //@ maintaining i+1 <= j && j <= nVert;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p < q && q < nVert && p < i; adjacencyMat[p][q] == adjacencyMat[q][p]);
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i+1 <= k && k < j; adjacencyMat[i][k] == adjacencyMat[k][i]);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases nVert - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;

        long res = 0;
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@ requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE && y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
    //@ pure
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;

        //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n;
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n + (long) j;
            //@ loop_writes res, j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
```

```
    //@  requires x != null && y != null;
    //@  requires x.length == y.length;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == \forall int i; 0 <= i < x.length; x[i] == y[y.length - 1 - i];
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index <= x.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int i; 0 <= i < index; x[i] == y[y.length - 1 - i];
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {

            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class Max {
    //@  requires a == null || a.length == 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ also
    //@  requires a != null && a.length > 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length; a[j] <= \result;
    //@  ensures \exists int k; 0 <= k < a.length; a[k] == \result;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int max(int[] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        int res = a[0];

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; a[j] <= res;
        //@ maintaining \exists int j; 0 <= j < i; a[j] == res;
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases a.length - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            res = ((a[i] > res) ? a[i] : res);
        }
        return res;
```

```
public class IsStrictlyDecreasing {
    public static boolean IsStrictlyDecreasing(int[] arr) {
        int n = arr.length;
        if (n < 2) {
            return true;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (arr[i] <= arr[i + 1])
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
```

```
public class DivArrayByTwo {

```
```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));

    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    //@  requires a == null || a.length == 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ also
    //@  requires a != null && a.length > 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length;
    //@                        a[i] != null &&
    //@                        a[i].length == a.length &&
    //@                        (\forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length;
    //@                            (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0)));
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining n == a.length;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
        //@                  a[k] != null &&
        //@                  a[k].length == n &&
        //@                  (\forall int l; 0 <= l < n; (k == l ? a[k][l] == 1 : a[k][l] == 0)));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining n == a.length;
            //@ maintaining a[i] != null && a[i].length == n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
            //@                  a[k] != null &&
            //@                  a[k].length == n &&
            //@                  (\forall int l; 0 <= l < n; (k == l ? a[k][l] == 1 : a[k][l] == 0)));
            //@ maintaining (\forall int l; 0 <= l < j; (i == l ? a[i][l] == 1 : a[i][l] == 0));
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ also
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@  ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < a.length; a[k] == \old(a[k])) && (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < b.length; b[k] == \old(b[k]));
    //@  ensures \result != a && \result != b;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
```

```
        return true;
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires x.length != y.length;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ also
    //@  requires x != null && y != null;
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r < mat.length; mat[r] != null && mat[r].length == mat[0].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ also
    //@   requires mat.length == 0;
    //@   ensures \result == true;
    //@ also
    //@   requires mat.length > 0;
    //@   ensures \result == (\forall int i; 1 <= i < mat.length; \forall int j; 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1]);
```

```
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result != null;
      @   ensures \result.length == A.length;
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length;
      @                \result[i] != null && \result[i].length == A[0].length);
      @   ensures \fresh(\result) && (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length; \fresh(\result[i]));
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length;
      @               (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < A[0].length;
      @                    \result[i][j] == A[A.length-1-i][A[0].length-1-j]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k && k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];
        //@ assert ret != null;
        //@ assert ret.length == m;
        //@ assert (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < m; ret[r] != null && ret[r].length == n);

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < i;
        //@                (\forall int c; 0 <= c && c < n;
        //@                     ret[r][c] == A[m-1-r][n-1-c]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*][*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < i;
            //@                (\forall int c; 0 <= c && c < n;
            //@                     ret[r][c] == A[m-1-r][n-1-c]));
            //@ maintaining (\forall int c; 0 <= c && c < j;
            //@                ret[i][c] == A[m-1-i][n-1-c]);
            //@ loop_writes ret[*][*], j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @  requires true;
      @  // Case: input is null -> result is null
      @  ensures arr == null ==> \result == null;
      @
      @  // Case: input is non-null -> result is a fresh array of same length
      @  ensures arr != null ==> \result != null;
      @  ensures arr != null ==> \result.length == arr.length;
      @  ensures arr != null ==> \fresh(\result);
      @
      @  // For each position, output follows the algorithm:
      @  // if input is whitespace, output is the same char;
      @  // otherwise if it is the start of a word (i == 0 or previous char is whitespace),
      @  // output is Character.toTitleCase(input);
      @  // otherwise output is Character.toLowerCase(input).
      @  ensures arr != null ==>
      @    (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < arr.length;
      @        (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ? \result[i] == arr[i]
      @         : ((i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]))
      @             ? \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])
      @             : \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))));
      @
      @  // method does not modify the given input array
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        /*@ 
          @  maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
          @  maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) || (i == 0 && wordStart == true);
          @  maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @               (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ? ret[j] == arr[j]
          @                : ((j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))
          @                   ? ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])
          @                   : ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j])));
          @  loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
          @  decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
        if (x < 0) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {

                return null;

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
```

```
    //@  requires a != null && a.length > 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] <= \result) && (\exists int j; 0 <= j && j < a.length; a[j] == \result);
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static int max(int[] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        int res = a[0];

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i; res >= a[k]);
        //@ maintaining (\exists int k; 0 <= k && k < i; res == a[k]);
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases a.length - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            res = ((a[i] > res) ? a[i] : res);
        }
        return res;
    }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;

    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {

            sign = -sign;

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {

}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
    //@  pure
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;

        if (y < 0) {

            //@ loop_writes res, j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
```

```
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < original.length; \result[i] == original[original.length - 1 - i]);
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; res[j] == original[n - 1 - j]);
        //@ loop_writes res[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
        }
        return res;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        /*@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j+1 < nums.length && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j+1]);
          @ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j+1 < nums.length && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j+1]);
          @ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
      @ requires b != null;
      @ requires a != null;
      @ requires a != b;
      @ requires 0 <= iBegin && iBegin <= iEnd && iEnd <= b.length && iEnd <= a.length;
      @ assigns a[iBegin .. iEnd - 1];
      @ ensures (\forall int k; iBegin <= k && k < iEnd; a[k] == \old(b[k]));
      @ ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < a.length && !(iBegin <= k && k < iEnd); a[k] == \old(a[k]));
      @ ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < b.length; b[k] == \old(b[k]));
      @*/
    public static void CopyArray(int[] b, int iBegin, int iEnd, int[] a) {
        int k = iBegin;

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining iBegin <= k && k <= iEnd;
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; iBegin <= j && j < k; a[j] == \old(b[j]));
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < a.length && !(iBegin <= j && j < k); a[j] == \old(a[j]));
          @ loop_writes a[iBegin .. iEnd - 1], k;
          @ decreases iEnd - k;
          @*/
        while (iEnd - k > 0) {
            a[k] = b[k];
            k = k + 1;
        }
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyDecreasing {
    public static boolean IsStrictlyDecreasing(int[] arr) {
        int n = arr.length;
        if (n < 2) {
            return true;
```

```
public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }

        return true;

}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    /*@ 
      @   // Case: invalid inputs or overflow -> return null
      @   requires a == null || b == null || (long)a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      @   assigns \result;
      @   ensures \result == null;
      @
      @ also
      @
      @   // Case: valid inputs -> return concatenated array
      @   requires a != null && b != null && (long)a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      @   assigns \result, \result[*];
      @   ensures \result != null;
      @   ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
      @   ensures \result != a && \result != b;
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i]);
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i]);
      @   // inputs are not modified
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] == \old(a[i]));
      @   ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; b[i] == \old(b[i]));
      @
      @   behavior complete;
      @   behavior disjoint;
      @*/
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        /*@ 
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
          @   // elements at positions >= i may be unchanged or already set
          @   loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @   decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < m; ret[j] == a[j]);
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j]);
          @   loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @   decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }
```

```
            return false;

        int i = 0;
```
```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    /*@
      // Exactly when null is returned: iff an input is null or lengths would overflow
      ensures (\result == null) <==> (a == null || b == null || (long)a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE);

      // If a non-null array is returned then inputs were non-null and lengths fit in an int
      ensures (\result != null) ==> (a != null && b != null && (long)a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE);

      // The returned array is freshly allocated, non-aliased to the inputs, and has exact length m+n
      ensures (\result != null) ==> \fresh(\result);
      ensures (\result != null) ==> \result != a && \result != b;
      ensures (\result != null) ==> \result.length == a.length + b.length;

      // Exact contents: first copy a entirely in order, then b entirely in order.
      // This fully characterizes the returned array for the non-null case.
      ensures (\result != null) ==>
        (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < \result.length;
           (k < a.length ? \result[k] == a[k] : \result[k] == b[k - a.length]));

      // Inputs are not modified in the non-null case (and obviously not modified in the null case)
      ensures (\result != null) ==>
               (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] == \old(a[i]));
      ensures (\result != null) ==>
               (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; b[i] == \old(b[i]));

      // No other memory reachable from the caller is modified by this method.
      // (Writes performed by the implementation are to the newly allocated result array only,
      // which is captured by \fresh(\result) above.)
      assignable \nothing;
    @*/
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        /*@ 
          @   // Loop 1: copy a[0..m-1] into ret[0..m-1]
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
          @   maintaining ret.length == m + n;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
          @   loop_writes ret[*];
          @   decreases m - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        /*@ 
          @   // Loop 2: copy b[0..n-1] into ret[m..m+n-1]
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @   maintaining ret.length == m + n;
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < m; ret[j] == a[j]);
          @   maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j]);
          @   loop_writes ret[*];
          @   decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @ behavior arr_null:
      @   assumes arr == null;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == null;
      @
      @ also
      @
      @ behavior arr_non_null:
      @   assumes arr != null;
      @   assigns \result, \result[*];
      @   ensures \result != null;

      @   ensures \result != arr;
      @   ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i && i < arr.length ==>

      @             ? \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])
      @             : \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i])));
      @   ensures \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < arr.length ==> arr[j] == \old(arr[j]);
      @
      @ behavior complete;
      @ behavior disjoint;
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

        boolean wordStart = true;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result <==> (a != null && a.length > 0 && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length;
    //@              a[i] != null && a[i].length == a.length &&
    //@              (\forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length; (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0))));
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
        //@                 a[k] != null && a[k].length == n &&
        //@                 (\forall int l; 0 <= l < n; (k == l ? a[k][l] == 1 : a[k][l] == 0)));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int c; 0 <= c < j; (i == c ? a[i][c] == 1 : a[i][c] == 0));
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
```
```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
            //@ decreases n - j;
```

```
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j+1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
```

```
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ behavior complete;

    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {

            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```
